items.information: # Registration is closed and the waitlist is now full. ![West Coast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png) - This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) - Bay Area Speedcubin' is bringing it's first competition in beautiful Pacifica, California! items.name: Flower City Cube Fest 2022
items.information: Events: 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, Clock, Square-1, and Skewb **Competitors may bring at most one guest.** # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue: - **They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19.** To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after **Saturday, July 16** is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR - **They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition.** The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than **Tuesday, July 26** is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

items.information: 午前に行われる大田2022夏 (以下、AM大会) と午後に行われる大田BLD2022夏 (以下、PM大会) は 、WCA Competition Requirements Policy で定められているところの「Series Competitions」となります。 このため、いずれかの大会の申込みのみが承認されます。 両方に申込んだ場合は、申込日時が早い方を受理し、申込日時が遅い方は無効とします。悪しからずご了承ください。 なお、AM大会とPM大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 * AM大会は、3x3x3 キューブの1種目のみです。 * PM大会は、3x3x3 目隠しの1種目のみです。 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛に大会2日前までにメールを送ってください。 詳細は「見学の申請」のタブをご確認ください。 Ota Summer 2022 (AM) and Ota Blind Summer 2022 (PM) are "Series Competitions" defined in the WCA Competition Requirements Policy. Therefore, you can register either of these competitions. If you register for both competitions, the earlier one will only be recieved, and the later one will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for AM and PM are different. * AM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 cube. * PM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 blindfolded. The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, please be sure to email the organization team before 28th July. Please find "Request of observation as a visitor" tab in detail.
